format_row_to_tensor: format a single row from a pyarrow table into a mapping of torch tensors
format_column_to_tensor: format a single column from a pyarrow table into a consolidated torch tensor
format_batch_to_tensor: format a batch from a pyarrow table into a mapping of consolidated torch tensors
recursive_tensorize_dict: recursively convert a nested dictionary of numpy arrays and lists into torch tensors
tensorize_single_value: convert a single numpy value or PIL image into a torch tensor with default dtype
